title: Cities that formally bid to host the Summer Olympics

source.name: List of bids for the Summer Olympics
source.publisher: International Olympic Committee bid records, compiled via Wikipedia/topendsports.com

notes: Count of cities that formally submitted a bid for each Summer Olympics host cycle. The IOC awarded 2024 and 2028 simultaneously in 2017 after most 2024 challengers withdrew, leaving only Paris and Los Angeles.
